title: AI numbered report directory omitted cited current task sources
problem: Current Threat Graph and AI SOC Analyst task sources were cited by capability records but omitted from the numbered directory. The first held Triage candidate added a third unmatched citation. The renderer numbered these references zero and report anchors had no targets.

versions: Published Site 262 baseline; repaired November 2 candidate
exclusions: This is a VersionCompass source-directory mapping defect, not a Splunk product availability, entitlement or authorization determination. Vendor facts and earlier verification dates are unchanged.

impact.customerScenario: A reader follows the exact supporting source from a printed or saved AI Availability report.
impact.consequence: The source record exists and screen external links remain usable, but citation zero and missing internal directory targets weaken report traceability.

confidence.rationale: Commit-pinned public canonical mappings and the actual report engine were inspected; a regression reproduced the missing directory source before repair.

lifecycle.reason: Preserve the defect and its bounded repair assessment; no automatic downstream closure.

evidence.statement: Published Site 262 baseline; two task-source directory omissions. Missing numbered-directory IDs: aiEsThreatGraph88, aiEsSocTask88. Source records exist, but their print/saved-HTML directory targets are absent.

documentRevision.qualification: Exact public commit-pinned JSON bytes; this verifies the website source mapping, not vendor capability truth.
